subject: JUDGE: review @zonoid/cli install hardening (self-learn-judge single-attempt)
description:
Skill-tagged judge task. When the impl task's attempt completes, invoke the `self-learn-judge` skill in SINGLE-ATTEMPT REVIEW MODE against the impl's attempt branch (orch/attempt/<impl-key>). Fetch the diff via get_attempt_diff and apply the code-review rubric: correctness, scope discipline, dead/redundant code, test presence/quality, style.

Verify the impl's 5 invariants specifically:
1. checkInstallDir() can NEVER `rm -rf`/delete a directory containing live data (overlay/sessions/worktrees/workspace/token). Confirm there is a dirHasLiveData guard and no remaining `execSync('rm -rf ...')`.
2. Cross-platform: no Unix-only shell commands; skills install has symlink→junction→copy fallback.
3. resolveInstallDir prefers a complete local checkout (daemon.js+mcp-graph.js+package.json) over cloning.
4. The claude harness path delegates wiring to bin/install.js (Node .js hooks, full hook set) rather than the stale .sh sample — no behavioral drift from bin/install.js.
5. Tests in test/cli-init.test.js cover the new predicates and pass; existing tests stay green. Run `node test/cli-init.test.js`.

APPROVE (hold-merge verdict — loop records, does not auto-merge for a flat task) if the rubric + invariants pass. Otherwise KICK BACK: set_status failed + a wired record_decision explaining the gap. NEVER force-merge.

summary: APPROVE (flat tier → HOLD for main). Independently verified all 5 invariants in commit 049688a; re-ran tests from the attempt worktree (exit 0, 27/27). Held P done with ⏸ MERGE PENDING — judge does NOT merge; dispatcher owns feature→main. 3 non-blocking concerns recorded (skills-fallback test covers only the symlink branch; protectedNames omits runtime state files; pre-existing unquoted git clone).
